# Check if "spiral galaxy" has the least apparent magnitude among all object types
# First, get the minimum apparent magnitude for each object type
min_mag_by_type = df.groupby('object type')['apparent magnitude'].min()

# Find the object type with the smallest minimum apparent magnitude
type_with_min_mag = min_mag_by_type.idxmin()

# Check if this type is exactly "spiral galaxy"
answer = (type_with_min_mag == 'spiral galaxy')
